violation_type.title: Field Trips - Ensure Safety (26 TAC §746.3001)
violation_type.typical_finding: Director allowed children to go to a building that was not part of the operation's floor plan.

finding_variants.text: Director allowed children to go to a building that was not part of the operation's floor plan.
The operation went on a field trip and there were no signed permission forms from the parent or identifiable shirt or name on the children at the time of inspection.

The operation was not following all field trip requirements when taking children for walks around the neighborhood. Some examples include: children did not wear any identifying information with the operation's name and phone number such as a shirt or nametag; permission slips were not always signed; there was no 48-hour notice posted; emergency consents or contact information was not taken.

Based on the information gained during the investigation, the center did not use a written list of all children on the field trip. The shirts worn by the children did not include the daycare's phone number.
It was found that the operation does not provide permission slips for field trips, ensure children have visible identifying information, or provide parents with 48 hours prior notification.
Children were taken to an area outside the operation's licensed space without their parental consent or permission slips.
